title: EU Parliament Votes to Delay AI Act Compliance Deadlines
summary: The European Parliament delayed compliance deadlines for high-risk AI systems under the EU AI Act, offering more time for companies to meet requirements. Concurrently, it banned specific harmful AI applications, like 'nudify' tools. This reflects a balance between fostering innovation and addressing AI risks.
sentiment_reason: The decision to delay compliance deadlines is seen as a measure to prevent unintended safety gaps and superficial compliance, while the ban on harmful AI applications shows a commitment to addressing immediate and severe risks.
